children: , the near-monopoly supplier of advanced chipmaking lithography systems, jumped 2.25% higher at 1,500.40 Monday as semiconductor shares rallied. The Dutch giant carries a market capitalization of approximately 586.28 billion, reflecting its unmatched position at the heart of advanced chip production.

The company's latest results delivered 9.33 billion in quarterly sales, a 54% gross margin and 2.92 billion in net income. Management expects full-year revenue of 43 billion to 45 billion while pushing EUV and immersion-lithography capacity sharply higher through 2028.

The shares now trade 36.63% above their GF Value estimate of roughly $1,260, signaling that investors already expect exceptional execution. At approximately 13.3 times the 44 billion revenue-guidance midpoint, ASML has little room for an AI spending slowdown, weaker customer orders or margin pressure. Its technological scarcity remains formidablebut the stock price is charging investors heavily for it.

title: ASML Jumps 2.3% as Its 586 Billion Valuation Chases AI Factories
